title: Mercury Script Hub
features:
Just some random script hub with a really nice UI that I've been working on for a little bit. I plan to actually make this an actual decently big project I might work on for a while. So let me know what you think I should add!
Changelog:
Added new icons for the tabs (No more moons everywhere)
Added game script hub tab (Definitely adding more scripts later)
Added new default theme (Rust)
Added 2 more scripts in the universal scripts tab
And probably more than I'm forgetting about

One thing, if the script doesn't work when you first execute it, thats normal. Just execute it again and you'll be good.
